sloka: यस्या ह्येवंविधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते ।सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम् ।। ५.५८.८८ ।।।।
transliteration: yasyā hyevaṁvidhaḥ svapno duḥkhitāyāḥ pradṛśyate ।sā duḥkhairvividhairmuktā sukhamāpnotyanuttamam ।। 5.58.88 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Whoever in a sorrowful state sees such kind of dream, would be not only relieved of all sorrows but will experience immense happiness. Janaka's daughter Sita will bless us with protection if we pray her.
